title: Apology Z
description: zombie apocalipse in your minecraft world
body:
THIS DATA PACK IS ONLY FOR !1.19.4!

Data pack have multiplayer compatibility!

Resource pack is !REQUIRED!

Immerse yourself in an apocalyptic zombie world where you must fight to survive various dangers such as radioactive disasters, zombies and the infection itself

Explore and scavange in mundane buildings that were devastated by zombies

Discover and build technology that will be of great help for your long journey
